strings.zh: 奇怪？听不大清楚,{NEWLINE}电话坏了吗？{SCROLL}你换个地方再打试试！
strings.en: Pardon? I can’t hear you very well...{NEWLINE}We must have a bad connection.{SCROLL}Try calling again from somewhere else!

strings.zh: 喂喂⋯⋯{NEWLINE}你身体怎么样？{CLEAR}我当然很好啦！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello...{NEWLINE}How have you been keeping?{SCROLL}I am quite well, of course.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 只要不断旅行{NEWLINE}就能不断遇到强大的对手。{CLEAR}所以你可不能松懈啊。
strings.en: As long as you keep traveling, you{NEWLINE}will keep meeting strong opponents.{CLEAR}So you mustn’t let your guard down.

strings.zh: 我星期天的早上{NEWLINE}时间很充裕。{SCROLL}到时候{NEWLINE}请打电话来吧。
strings.en: My Sunday mornings are rather free.{SCROLL}Please do call me then.

strings.zh: 来得正好,{NEWLINE}我现在正无聊呢。{SCROLL}要和我{NEWLINE}再来对战一场吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: What perfect timing. I was{NEWLINE}just feeling a little idle.{SCROLL}Would you care for another battle? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 哇,好高兴！{NEWLINE}这下又多了一个乐趣,{SCROLL}我在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋等你！
strings.en: Oh, how delightful! Now I have one{NEWLINE}more thing to look forward to.{SCROLL}I’ll be waiting for you at the Trainer{NEWLINE}House at the Battle Frontier.
strings.notes: US 0646/6 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 啊呀？{NEWLINE}你现在有很多{CLEAR}和别人的约定啊,{CLEAR}不要放别人鸽子哦。
strings.en: Oh my? You already have a number{NEWLINE}of promises with others, don’t{CLEAR}you? You mustn’t stand them up.

strings.zh: 我在战斗前线的训练家屋{NEWLINE}等着你,{CLEAR}不要忘了啊。
strings.en: I’ll be waiting for you at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle{CLEAR}Frontier. Please don’t forget.
strings.notes: US 0646/9 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 难道你忘了{NEWLINE}我们在战斗前线的训练家屋{CLEAR}对战的约定了吗？
strings.en: Have you forgotten our promise{NEWLINE}to battle at the Trainer{CLEAR}House at the Battle Frontier?
strings.notes: US 0646/11 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 你喜欢植物吗？{NEWLINE}植物是非常柔弱的。{SCROLL}水量的变化,{NEWLINE}土地的质量,{CLEAR}气温的变化,{CLEAR}天气的好坏,{CLEAR}只要这些{CLEAR}有些许的改变,{CLEAR}就会造成巨大影响。
strings.en: Do you like plants?{NEWLINE}Plants are such delicate things.{SCROLL}The amount of water,{NEWLINE}the condition of the soil,{CLEAR}the temperature differences,{CLEAR}the changing weather...{CLEAR}All those little things we don’t think{CLEAR}about can have such a huge effect.

strings.zh: 你喜欢占卜吗？{SCROLL}我对于⋯⋯{NEWLINE}花瓣丝{CLEAR}和切树叶的占卜方法{CLEAR}不怎么⋯⋯{SCROLL}啊,这并不是说我讨厌{NEWLINE}紫苑镇里那位{CLEAR}很有名的占卜师啦。
strings.en: Do you like fortune-telling?{SCROLL}Me...{SCROLL}I’m not very fond of the kinds where{NEWLINE}you pluck flower petals or cut leaves...{SCROLL}Oh, but that doesn’t mean I dislike the{NEWLINE}famous fortune-teller in Lavender Town.
strings.notes: US 0646/13 | RV070: omission: US dropped leaf-cutting divination and famous (D-1915)

strings.zh: 晚上该睡觉的时候你会干嘛呢？{SCROLL}我会在道馆{NEWLINE}进行植物的移植,{CLEAR}用小毛笔掸掉{CLEAR}花和树叶上的灰尘。{CLEAR}好忙啊⋯⋯
strings.en: What do you do at night,{NEWLINE}when you ought to be asleep?{SCROLL}I transplant the plants in my Gym and{NEWLINE}dust the flowers and leaves with a{CLEAR}little brush. It keeps me so busy...
